newsitem.title: HONG KONG: Miraculous escape as HK tanker truck explodes.
newsitem.headline: Miraculous escape as HK tanker truck explodes.

text.p: Drivers and pedestrians fled for their lives on Monday after a fireball engulfed a busy Hong Kong highway.
Police said a tanker truck loaded with petrol exploded in a chain reaction accident begun when a truck carrying motorcycles overturned and some of the motorcycles burst into flames.
Firemen fought dozens of small blazes which lapped at the twisted metal and shredded rubber tyres, blanketing the street with thick, greasy smoke.
Police said they were amazed the inferno and resulting traffic pile-up claimed no lives.
Two people were taken to hospital but their injuries were not serious, a police spokesman said.
